basis.primary_source: World-Atlas-Draft-V1.md sections 2–6, especially section 4 continent relief notes and section 6 construction order
basis.note: V0.8 visualizes prior relief candidates and defines bathymetric vocabulary. It is not a DEM, geologic reconstruction, or ocean-depth model.

candidates: Long mountain belt in west or northwest
Broad basin or plain separating relief systems
unresolved: whether central basin is closed or open

candidates: Incomplete mountain arc from northwest to central region
Highlands and hills dividing drainage basins
Possible downstream floodplains, wetlands and humid forests only if climate supports
Elongated mountain range on one side
Highland on the opposite side potentially creating rain shadow
Mountains or highlands in central-northern region
Glaciers, glacial valleys and fjords only if glacial history and relief support
Possible volcanic arc or volcanic plateau on one side
Fault valley or basin separating highlands
Main mountain belt near one long coast
Interior basin possibly draining to enclosed bay or large lake
unresolved: whether basin is closed or connected to sea

bathymetry.status: Conceptual vocabulary only; no geographic bathymetry assigned.
bathymetry.cross_section: Generic shelf-to-slope-to-abyssal-plain-to-margin diagram; not measured or geographically placed.

limitations: All relief placements are schematic interpretations of existing draft notes, not new CANON.
No numeric elevations or ocean depths are assigned.
The plate reference is recovered rounded spherical data, not original exact planar geometry.
No plate-motion vectors or boundary kinematics are available; tectonic landforms cannot be derived from boundary positions alone.
Ocean basin boundaries and bathymetric topology are not validated.
No rivers, lakes, biomes, rainfall or regional climates are assigned.
The SVG coordinate scaffold is linear and is not a validated cartographic projection.
